$media-ingest-flow.description: TARGET-SET ingest path (post-pivot): the browser drags a file onto a SPECIFIC doc on canvas → POST /api/media/ingest with targetDocPath → #ingest-dispatch routeIngestWithTarget(filename, targetDocPath, targetDocKind) → IngestRoute dispatch to compose-video / add-audio-clip / reject. The no-target path that historically scaffolded a doc-per-drop is gone — see $media-bin-flow + $canvas-compose-flow for the post-pivot creator loop. Spans the studio HTTP handler, #ingest-dispatch (routeIngestWithTarget only), and #compose-video-project or #timeline-ops depending on the route.

steps.action: receive POST /api/media/ingest with targetDocPath, stream upload into media/<basename>
classifyMediaFile + routeIngestWithTarget (file-kind, target doc kind)
compose-video target — add clip layer to existing video doc
add-audio-clip target — register audio clip on audio track
on reject, unlink the just-uploaded file and respond 400

$media-bin-flow.description: NO-TARGET media-bin acquire path (v1.0 media-bin pivot, TD-2026-05-28). Creator drops a file onto the sidebar / page level → POST /api/media/ingest with no targetDocPath → upload stream lands at media/<basename> → #handle-no-target-bin-add invokes routeIngest (kind+add-to-bin/reject only) → on accept: broadcasts {type:"media:list:changed"} (!media-added), fires background transcribeMediaToBin for video/audio, emits media:ingest:progress envelopes (transcribing→done|error) → workspace-app refreshes MEDIA sidebar + #bin-add-toast surfaces success → transcripts/<stem>.json written. CRITICAL: this path does NOT compose. Replaces the pre-pivot $media-ingest-flow no-target branch (which auto-scaffolded a doc per drop).

steps.action: receive POST /api/media/ingest (no targetDocPath), stream upload into media/<basename>
routeIngest → reject (unlink + 400) or add-to-bin
broadcast !media-added (media:list:changed); start background transcribe for video/audio
transcribeMediaToBin writes transcripts/<stem>.json (idempotent on re-call)
workspace-app receives media:ingest:progress envelopes, ToastHost surfaces success

$canvas-compose-flow.description: Explicit-compose path (v1.0 media-bin pivot). Creator clicks "+ new doc" → #studio-new-doc-modal three-tile picker → empty .atelier created via $doc-create-flow → drags a media-ref row from the MEDIA sidebar onto canvasMount or timelineMount → #media-ref-drop-target validates payload via isValidMediaRefPath, POSTs /api/media/ingest?source=existing&path=media/<basename> with the current doc as targetDocPath → server runs ^valid-media-ref-path then dispatches through routeIngestWithTarget → composeVideoProject (or add-audio-clip) runs against the already-binned media + cached transcript → doc-mutated WS envelope → canvas + #timeline-view refresh. The compose verb is decoupled from the acquire verb — see ~media-bin-acquire-vs-compose.

steps.action: creator clicks "+ new doc" on the DOCS row
three-tile picker → POST /api/project/:name/docs creates empty .atelier
creator drags a MEDIA sidebar row (application/x-atelier-media-ref payload) onto canvas/timeline
attachMediaRefDropTarget validates path, POSTs /api/media/ingest?source=existing&path=<media-ref>&targetDocPath=<doc>
handleExistingSourceIngest → ^valid-media-ref-path → routeIngestWithTarget
compose against existing media + cached transcript, write doc, broadcast doc-mutated
refresh bottom timeline from updated doc.timeline

$rename-cascade-flow.description: One rename op cascades through media/, transcripts/, and project.atelier (assets, layers, timeline). Phase 1 stages every change in memory (load doc → apply rename walk → recompute timeline → scan artifacts for warnings) without touching disk. Phase 2 writes in order: media file → transcript (if present) → doc; on any mid-step failure the prior writes are reverse-rolled-back best-effort before the original error is rethrown. Triggered from either the studio HTTP endpoint or the MCP tool wrapper; both gate on ^valid-media-basename before entry, and both join straight into <projectDir>/media/<basename> so the basename guard is load-bearing.

steps.action: validate basenames (^valid-media-basename), parse JSON body
Phase 1 — load doc, applyMediaRenameToDoc, recomputeTimeline, scan artifacts
Phase 2 — rename media file
Phase 2 — rename transcript if present (rollback media on failure)
Phase 2 — write project.atelier (rollback transcript + media on failure)

$doc-create-flow.description: Sidebar "+ new doc" → NewDocDialog three-tile picker (video / image / carousel) with live slug preview → POST /api/project/:name/docs → handler runs ^valid-doc-name then createDoc → composeImageProject / composeVideoProject / composeCarouselProject (each with its docPath) builds the doc → file written under <projectDir>/<slug>.atelier → handler broadcasts {type:"doc:list:changed", projectName} on the bridge WS → every connected workspace-app sidebar refreshes its single flat DOCS group. Adding a slide to a carousel goes through the parallel #carousel-add-slide-button affordance on the carousel canvas, which POSTs asCarouselSlide:true so createDoc additionally runs composeCarouselProject to append a SlideRef (cycle-checked).

steps.action: render "+ new doc" affordance on the DOCUMENT label row
collect kind + name (+ slide toggle), preview slug
POST /api/project/:name/docs, gate ^valid-doc-name + ^doc-path-inside-project
createDoc → composeImage|Video|Carousel (each with docPath), write file
broadcast !doc-list-changed envelope
refresh single flat DOCS group on doc:list:changed

$doc-delete-cascade-flow.description: Right-click on a sidebar doc row → context menu → Delete… → ConfirmDialog → DELETE /api/project/:name/docs?path=<rel> → handler gates ^valid-doc-name (on the basename) + ^doc-path-inside-project → deleteDoc walks every sibling project subdir in the workspace, scans every .atelier doc encountered, removes matching SlideRef entries from any carousel doc, collects dangling RefVisual layers into a report (NOT auto-removed per ~doc-dangling-refvisual-reported), and unlinks the target doc → broadcast !doc-list-changed → sidebars refresh. If the currently-open doc in the bridge was the one deleted, the bridge falls back to the next available doc in the project (post-pivot: there is no privileged manifest to fall back to — see ~no-manifest-doc) or shows the empty-canvas state if the project has no docs left.

steps.action: right-click → context menu → Delete…
DELETE /api/project/:name/docs?path=, gate ^valid-doc-name + ^doc-path-inside-project
deleteDoc → workspace-wide SlideRef scrub across every .atelier + RefVisual dangling scan + unlink
broadcast !doc-list-changed
refresh; bridge falls back to next available doc or empty-canvas state
